description: Implementation of ProductAttributeService interface for managing product attributes, including methods for retrieval, saving, updating, and deleting ProductAttribute entities within the sales manager e-commerce system.

classes.name: ProductAttributeServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing product attribute management operations, extending generic service and integrating with DAO for persistence.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieve a ProductAttribute by its primary key ID.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Fetch list of ProductAttributes associated with a specific option ID within a given store.

methods.name: getByAttributeIds
methods.description: Retrieve ProductAttributes matching a list of attribute IDs within a store.

methods.name: getByOptionValueId
methods.description: Get list of ProductAttributes with a specific option value ID.

methods.name: getByProductId
methods.description: Retrieve all ProductAttributes associated with a specific product in a merchant store.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Persist a new ProductAttribute or update an existing one.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Remove a ProductAttribute after ensuring it is fetched by ID to avoid detached instance issues.
